jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Family Justice Center (the “Center”) is a warm and welcoming one-stop center for victims of interpersonal violence (IPV) -- domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, elder abuse and human trafficking. The Center serves victims and survivors regardless of their income, immigration status or location. The Center is a public-private partnership committed to creating a vibrant community free of coercion and fear. It supports the West Center located in Richmond, the Central Center in Concord, the East Center in Antioch, the South Center in Danville, and the Solano Center in Fairfield.

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

We are accepting applications for one full-time Program Coordinator. We provide generous fringe benefits, including paid holidays, paid annual and sick leave, health insurance coverage, dental and vision coverages, life insurance and retirement

benefits.

Program Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and supporting the organization's long term safety programs for youth and adults.

· Coordinate special projects (festivals, community listening sessions, workshops, informational meetings).

· Data input, reporting and documentation.

· Facilitation, planning and preparation of monthly community group gatherings, program cohorts, volunteers/interns, multidisciplinary team meetings that include clinicians, psychiatrists, navigators and partners.

· Supporting Site Director with end-to-end program and event coordination.

· Intake, scheduling, and follow up of program clients needed.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

· Review program goals and activities to meet program goals.

· Implement program initiatives & activities, oversee grant deliverables, and refine program designs.

· Coordination with partners, making referrals, following up regarding status of referred clients.

· Engage with partners through outreach.

· Document and report on program outcomes using organization databases like JotForm and Empowerdb.

· Perform other duties, function, special projects, and responsibilities as assigned and deemed necessary by the Site and Executive Director.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**:

· Demonstrated Knowledge of or a background in domestic violence, sexual assault, child abuse, stalking, elder abuse, or human trafficking.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills, including public speaking, attention to detail and proofreading.

· Strong analytical and organizational skills and problem-solving capabilities

· Proven project/program coordinator/management experience and report writing skills.

· Microsoft Word, Excel, Canva, Dropbox, and Google proficiency.

· High comfort with data collection and evaluation through Excel and Google Sheets.

· Ability and willingness to learn in new areas and practices.

· Teamwork and interpersonal flexibility.

· Able to work independently.

· Self-starter and takes initiative.

· Interest in learning and practicing leadership

· Cultural responsiveness and an alignment with our values and commitments to equity and inclusion.

· Fluency in Spanish or Asian languages is preferred.

· Ability to travel.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

· Bachelor’s Degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.

· Minimum of two years’ worth of experience relevant to the position: training, curriculum, development, program design, and implementation, coaching and victim advocacy.

**SPECIAL CONSIDERATION:**

· Ability to create effective social media posts.

· Excellence in website design and graphics.

· Superb writing skills.

· Ability to fix computers and troubleshoot technical issues.

· Interest in or experience with non-violence work.

· Innovative and creative self-starter.

· Interest in staff and organization development work.

· Deep understanding of public systems.

**We practice equity in all aspects of the organization and value diversity of culture, thought, and lived experiences. We seek talented, qualified individuals who will contribute to the culture of diversity and inclusion at the Family Justice Center.**

Pay: $29.00 - $33.00 per hour

Expected hours: 37.5 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Program Coordinator I
jobs.description:
At **Benchmark**, we are driven by our purpose: to innovate for a healthier, safer, and better-connected world to create a brighter future. When you join us, you become part of a team passionate about making a meaningful impact across various sectors, including commercial aerospace, defense, advanced computing, next-generation communications, complex industrials, medical, and semiconductor capital equipment. We prioritize career growth, fostering a culture that ensures you reach your full potential. At Benchmark, your work is purpose-driven, enabling you to create a positive impact on the world and make your career truly meaningful. You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive team that values your ideas and contributions.

**Summary**:  
Support the Program Managers for Engineering Change Orders, Sales Order management and Accounts Receivable. Support the Master Scheduler by providing daily reports using Baan. Ensure sales order accuracy to drive accurate MRP. Follow all procedures with consistent adherence to company policies and guidelines.

**Responsibilities**:  

* Analyze customer purchase orders for compliance to customer’s contract terms and conditions
* Verify pricing and process customer POs and Sales Orders in accurate and timely manner
* Proactively identify potential discrepancies prior to data entry and engage Program Managers in resolving discrepancies
* Maintain documentation and database to support pricing quoted to customers
* Assist Program Managers with program accounts receivable past-due balances, providing data necessary for resolution
* Provide daily reports to Master Scheduler using Baan to support production scheduling
* Maintain a positive, professional relationship with Benchmark team members
* All employees are responsible for the Quality of their work to ensure BEI meets, or exceeds Customer Satisfaction.

**Other information**:  

* Begin to understand the total business operation to include material procurement, order entry, forecasting, manufacturing, invoicing, customer returns, inventory levels and on-time delivery
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effective interpersonal skills
* Effective multitasking skills and the ability to take on additional responsibilities as required
* Effective organization and prioritization skills
* Demonstrate attention to detail
* Demonstrate discretion, confidentiality and professionalism when representing the company
* Ability to work overtime as needed
* Ability to work with diverse groups
* Participate in a continuous improvement activity
* High School Diploma or GED
* 0-2+ years of experience with Microsoft Office supporting mid-senior management levels

**Education:**

**Geographical Location:** California:Concord

**Physical Location:** Concord, CA - 4041

**Shift: Shift 1**

**Work Schedule:** M-F 0800-1700

**Full Time**

In our innovative environment, you'll work with cutting-edge technology, leading the way in engineering design and delivering world-class manufacturing services for products that make a real difference in the lives of others. At **Benchmark,** your career is more than just a job. It’s an opportunity to be part of something bigger, where your work matters and helps shape a brighter future for everyone. **Together, we will achieve extraordinary things.**

**Safety-Sensitive Position and Drug Testing Notice:** This position is classified as safety-sensitive because impairment while performing job duties could pose a significant risk of harm. Where permitted by applicable law or required by federal regulation, Benchmark will conduct a pre-employment drug screen. Benchmark maintains a drug- and alcohol-free workplace and may conduct reasonable-suspicion and post-incident testing in accordance with applicable law.

**Compensation Range:** $23.51 to $29.38 USD. Many factors are considered in compensation decisions, including but not limited to skills, certifications, licensures, experience, training, incumbent data, and other business needs.

**Benefits and Other Compensation:** Benchmark provides a comprehensive benefits package, including a Bonus Plan, 401(k), Paid Time Off, and Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance, all based on scheduled hours. Benchmark complies with applicable state and local employee leave laws.

**Application Deadline:** This job posting will remain open until filled.

**Additional Notices:** Benchmark adheres to applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits. This includes, but is not limited to, providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. Candidates applying for remote work based in Washington state, may obtain PTO eligibility for this position by emailing careers@bench.com.

**Export Control:** This position may involve access to information, technology, or materials that are regulated under U.S. export control laws. Employment in this role may be contingent upon verification that you qualify as a U.S. Person under federal regulations. U.S. Persons include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and individuals granted asylum or refugee status in the United States. If a candidate does not qualify as a U.S. Person, Benchmark will evaluate the position requirements and applicable legal restrictions to determine whether employment can proceed. In some cases, Benchmark may be unable to move forward with an application due to export control requirements.

Benchmark is an equal opportunity employer. We are bringing together a dynamic workforce with unique talents, life experiences, cultures, and perspectives to promote an innovative, collaborative, and creative place to work. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email us at careers@bench.com.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning Transformation Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

 **Job Description**

The E2E Planning Transformation Functional Program Manager is the program execution anchor for Western Digital's supply chain planning transformation portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President of Supply Chain Planning, this role drives cross-functional program management across the full suite of strategic transformation initiatives — from Kinaxis RapidResponse enablement and S&OP process redesign to LRP automation and Capital planning improvements. You design and own the Management Operating Structure of Supply Chain Planning & Capital group: initiative delivery, operational review infrastructure, business value realization, and organizational health tracking — not just status reporting.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1. Operational Review Infrastructure

Enable and organize the operational review cadence that feeds into key executive reviews — including Quarterly Business Reviews, annual planning cycles, and transformation portfolio reviews. Own the structure, preparation, content quality, and follow-through for each review gate so leadership always has a decision-ready view of the business.

2. Balanced Scorecard Creation & Operationalization

Help structure and operationalize a Balanced Scorecard for Supply Chain Planning and Capital — defining the right metrics across financial, operational, transformation, and talent dimensions. Translate executive intent into a living scorecard that is reviewed regularly and drives corrective action, not just reporting.

3. Transformation Portfolio Management

Own the program management of key supply chain planning transformation initiatives across WD's Planning and Capital functions. Define initiative charters, drive milestone accountability, track risks and interdependencies, and ensure each initiative is tied to a measurable business outcome — not just a project plan.

4. Interim Tools & Process Enhancements

Identify and drive interim solutions and near-term enhancements to planning tools and processes while longer-horizon transformation initiatives are underway. Bridge the gap between today's operational reality and tomorrow's target state — ensuring the planning team is not waiting on transformation to get better.

5. Leadership Initiative Tracking

Track leadership-directed initiatives from assignment through closure — maintaining a living tracker of open commitments, owners, due dates, and completion status. Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between leadership reviews, and surface at-risk items before they miss their window.

6. Headcount & Budget Tracking

Maintain visibility on transformation program headcount allocation and budget consumption across all initiatives. Track resource utilization, cost-to-complete, and variance to plan; escalate resource constraints and budget risks to leadership before they impact delivery. Own the monthly headcount and budget summary for the transformation portfolio.

7. Quarterly Transformation Newsletters

Create and distribute quarterly newsletters that communicate transformation progress, wins, and upcoming milestones to the broader Supply Chain Planning and Capital organization. Tell the story of what's changing, why it matters, and how each person fits into the transformation journey. Drive engagement and adoption through clear, consistent, outcome-focused communication.

8. Monthly Transformation Reviews

Own the monthly transformation review cadence — gathering status from initiative DRIs, synthesizing risks and blockers, tracking value realization, and preparing leadership with a clear decision-ready summary. Drive accountability for timeliness, accuracy, and forward-looking risk identification at each monthly touchpoint.

9. Business Process Owner Forum Coordination

Track and coordinate the Business Process Owner (BPO) forum — ensuring the right stakeholders are aligned on process changes, new system capabilities, and adoption requirements as transformation initiatives go live. Maintain the BPO community as the connection point between transformation teams and operational execution, surfacing adoption barriers and change management needs.

**What You Will Work On**

**Weekly: Transformation Ops Cadence**

Run the weekly transformation operating rhythm — initiative status reviews, leadership initiative tracker updates, blocker resolution, headcount/budget check-ins, and ops package inputs. Keep the portfolio moving without waiting for the monthly cycle.

**Monthly: Transformation Reviews & Scorecard Updates**

Own the monthly transformation review — gathering DRI updates, synthesizing risks, tracking value realization, updating the Balanced Scorecard, and monitoring headcount and budget consumption. Prepare leadership summary highlighting progress, risks, and resource status.

**Quarterly: QBRs, Portfolio Reviews & Newsletters**

Own preparation and execution of quarterly operational reviews and QBRs. Publish the quarterly transformation newsletter to the broader organization. Review portfolio health, resource allocation, and adoption momentum across all active initiatives.

**Ongoing: BPO Forum & Initiative Closure**

Track and facilitate the Business Process Owner (BPO) forum as the hub for process alignment and adoption coor

jobs.title: Vegetation Program Lead | San Jose/Santa Cruz/San Luis Obispo, CA
jobs.description:
To be considered for the position, we require you to complete an application on our careers page. Please use the following link to apply: Click here to apply on Eocene's website!

**COMPENSATION: $39.00 - $45.00 per hour**

**EXPLORE THE OUTDOORS. LEAD WITH PURPOSE. GROW YOUR CAREER.**

At Eocene Environmental Group, Inc., we’re not just managing vegetation—we’re protecting communities, enhancing ecosystems, and supporting the safe delivery of power across diverse landscapes. As a Vegetation Program Lead, your office is the great outdoors—from city streets to remote forests. You’ll lead field teams, coordinate with utility partners, and help shape sustainable right-of-way practices.

We’re an employee-owned company committed to innovation, safety, and professional development. As we expand nationwide, we’re looking for passionate leaders ready to grow with us.

**WHAT MAKES EOCENE DIFFERENT?**

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—benefits that set us apart from the competition:

* **Employee-Owned Company –** As an ESOP, every team member has a stake in our success and shares in the rewards.
* **Career Development Support –** We provide reimbursement for industry-related certifications and continuing education.
* **Company Vehicle for Work Use** – A company-provided vehicle is available for daily commute and work responsibilities.
* **Generous Paid Time Off** – Enjoy a strong PTO package from your first year, including vacation and personal wellness days.
* **Recognized Holidays** – Benefit from a comprehensive holiday schedule, including both standard and flexible days.
* **Workwear Allowance** – Annual support to help you stay safe and comfortable on the job.
* **Wellness Incentives** – Monthly reimbursement available for fitness memberships or wellness programs.
* **Competitive Health Coverage** – Access to robust medical, dental, and vision plans to support you and your family.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions:

* Lead vegetation management operations, contractor performance, project teams, and emergency response efforts in compliance with safety regulations and labor agreements.
* Solve moderate to highly complex problems independently; develop new approaches to improve processes and outcomes.
* Coordinate and support vegetation management (VM) activities, including scheduling, progress monitoring, and process improvement initiatives.
* At the direction of the PG&E Representative clarify expectations and program direction for contractor employees.
* Assist with customer interactions, including complaints, refusals, and access issues, as directed by the Program Manager.
* Support agency meetings, field visits, and project management tasks (routine and non-routine).
* Perform database “sleuthing” to identify and resolve issues.
* Provide support to Vegetation Management Inspectors (VMIs).
* Ensure on-site safety practices are followed and report on equipment and vehicle conditions.
* Perform other duties as assigned by PG&E representatives or EOCW management.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* Valid driver’s license and clean MVR
* Degree or experience in Forestry, Arboriculture, Environmental Science, or related field
* Leadership experience and familiarity with PG&E contractor work practices (preferred)
* Experience with emergency response or hazard tree removal (preferred)
* ISA Certified Arborist (preferred)
* Strong plant ID and invasive species knowledge
* Excellent communication and independent work skills
* Comfortable working in rugged terrain and varying weather conditions

***Ready to grow your career with Eocene? Apply today and help us share the future of utility Vegetation Management.***

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
The ams OSRAM Group is a global leader in innovative light and sensor solutions. As a specialist in Digital Photonics, we combine technological excellence with state-of-the-art global manufacturing capabilities to offer our customers the broadest portfolio of digital emitter and sensor technologies. Globally, our teams develop groundbreaking solutions aligned with societal megatrends like intelligent mobility, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, smart health, and robotics.

At ams OSRAM, employees are part of a highly innovative, international technology environment. Diverse teams, a high degree of ownership, and exciting challenges provide the opportunity to grow, develop, and make a real difference. Because behind our innovations are people who carry something special inside and who bring their unique strengths to work every day.

Show the world what you are made of.

Your new responsibilities

We are seeking a highly experienced Strategic Account Manager to lead and grow a key customer relationship within our semiconductor sensor portfolio. This role requires deep familiarity with silicon-based semiconductor technologies, strong technical sales acumen, and proven success managing complex, high-value strategic accounts.

The ideal candidate will bring direct experience working with a top strategic customer, along with a strong background in sensor technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as one of the primary commercial interfaces between the customer and internal teams (engineering, product marketing, operations)
* Drive design wins, long-term programs, and revenue growth
* Develop and execute account strategies, including opportunity mapping, competitive positioning, and growth plans
* Partner closely with FAEs and engineering to support customer design-in activities
* Navigate complex customer organizations, including procurement, engineering, and executive leadership
* Manage pricing strategy, contract negotiations, forecasts, and demand planning
* Identify new applications and system-level opportunities for sensor solutions

What we look for

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.
* 8 plus years of experience in strategic account management, technical sales, or customer-facing roles within the semiconductor industry.
* Strong contract negotiation, legal communication, and executive presence skills, with the ability to influence at multiple levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated experience supporting and growing relationships with large, strategic customers, including managing complex, long-term engagements.
* Strong technical understanding of silicon-based semiconductor technologies, with direct exposure to sensor products preferred.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product management, operations, and supply chain teams.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment and managing competing priorities across regions.
* Travel: up to 25% as needed to support key customer engagements locally and internationally.

Please contact **Joanely Ivette Mortimer** for further information via **Joanely.Mortimer@ams-osram.com**

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About AiDASH**  
  
AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

**The Role**

As our Executive Assistant & Office Manager, you'll run our Palo Alto office and make it a welcoming, well-organized space where our team can do their best work. You'll oversee office operations, coordinate executive schedules and travel, and manage the administrative details that keep a growing global company running smoothly.

You'll work closely with our leadership team and partners across People & Culture, Finance, and Recruiting. This role calls for someone who is proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity; someone who anticipates needs, takes ownership, and builds structure and processes as the company evolves.

If you enjoy wearing multiple hats, solving problems independently, and creating great experiences for both employees and visitors, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as we grow.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* **Office & Workplace Operations**
  + Own the day-to-day operations of our Palo Alto office, serving as the primary point of contact for vendors, facilities, and building management
  + Manage the daily lunch program, including vendor relationships, ordering, headcount, dietary requirements, and budget
  + Oversee office supplies, snacks, kitchen operations, and the upkeep of shared spaces
  + Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries
  + Coordinate office access and badges, meeting room setups, and AV requirements
  + Welcome and assist visitors, customers, partners, and candidates
* **Executive & Business Support**
  + Coordinate calendars, meetings, and travel arrangements for members of the leadership team
  + Arrange catering and logistics for leadership meetings, interview loops, and customer or partner visits
  + Lead the planning and execution of company offsites and leadership retreats, including venue selection, hotel accommodations, agendas, and on-site logistics
* **Employee Experience, Recruiting Coordination & Culture**
  + Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities and celebrations, including birthdays, work anniversaries, company milestones, and holiday events
  + Coordinate workspace and equipment setup for new hires, ensuring a smooth and welcoming first-day experience
  + Partner with Recruiting to coordinate interview schedules and deliver a seamless candidate experience
* **Administrative & Financial Operations**
  + Process invoices, expense reports, and purchase requests in partnership with Finance
  + Coordinate agreements and documents for signature through Adobe Sign and maintain accurate, organized records
  + Support general administrative tasks and special projects as business needs evolve

**What we're looking for:**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in office management, executive assistance, workplace operations, or a similar role, ideally within a high-growth startup
* 2 years of experience directly supporting senior executives, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel planning, and handling competing priorities
* 2 years of independently managing office operations or facilities, including vendor relationships and budgets
* Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a polished and professional approach
* Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
* A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems, and take initiative without waiting for direction
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
* Ability to work on-site in Palo Alto (3 days a week) and occasionally flex working hours to support teams across time zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a global organization with teams across multiple countries
* Experience planning company events, offsites, and leadership retreats, including group travel logistics
* Familiarity with tools such as Greenhouse, Adobe Sign, Expensify, or similar platforms

**What you'll love:**

* **Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage:** 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
* **Health Reimbursement Account (HRA):** 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
* **401(k) Plan:** Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered
* **Parental Leave:** Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Generous Vacation Policy:** Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you
* **Winter Break:** From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy

jobs.title: Training Specialist, Access Department, Part Time (24 hr week), Days
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MARINHEALTH**  
Are you looking for a place where you are empowered to bring innovation to reality? Join MarinHealth, an integrated, independent healthcare system with deep roots throughout the North Bay. With a world-class physician and clinical team, an affiliation with UCSF Health, an ever-expanding network of clinics, and a new state-of-the-art hospital, MarinHealth is growing quickly. MarinHealth comprises MarinHealth Medical Center, a 327-bed hospital in Greenbrae, and 55 primary care and specialty clinics in Marin, Sonoma, and Napa Counties. We attract healthcare’s most talented trailblazers who appreciate having the best of both worlds: the pioneering medicine of an academic medical center combined with an independent hospital's personalized, caring touch.

MarinHealth is already realizing the benefits of impressive growth and has consistently earned high praise and accolades, including being Named One of the Top 250 Hospitals Nationwide by Healthgrades, receiving a 5-star Ranking for Overall Hospital Quality from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and being named the Best Hospital in San Francisco/Marin by Bay Area Parent, among others.

**Company:**

Prima Medical Foundation dba MarinHealth Medical Network

**Work Shift:**

8 Hour (days) (United States of America)

**Scheduled Weekly Hours:**

24

**Job Description Summary:**

The Training Specialist identifies skill or knowledge gaps among the Patient Access department and all Patient Access Representatives, develops and delivers effective Patient Access training programs to enhance the efficiency of the Patient Access operations. The Training Specialist selects training tools and training delivery mechanisms, creates and maintains course content, manuals, toolkits, or other training materials, maintains records of training activities, monitors program effectiveness, and recommends improvements. They track and report on employee participation and assess outcomes and results. The Training Specialist analyzes patient access activities such as call flow and patterns, abandonment rates, and service quality. The specialist reports on findings and makes recommendations to improve productivity and efficiency, and benchmarks patient access processes.
  
  
Additionally, the Training Specialist assists and supports all Network Patient Access Representatives through onboarding, workflow assessments and training support for clinical practices, and assists as needed in department project support. This role will also support Revenue Cycle Training, inclusive of maintaining updates to ensure current effective reference materials for all Patient Access staff.

**Job Requirements, Prerequisites and Essential Functions:**

Pay Range:  
$31.25 - $37.50 - $43.75

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Manages the activities involved in the design, preparation, delivery, and needs assessments for training and development programs.
* Creates and implements curricula based on knowledge and understanding of business objectives and departmental needs.
* Provides tracking, documentation and monitors overall effectiveness of training programs.

Since 1907, Fairmont has served as the San Francisco residence for U.S. presidents, world leaders and entertainment stars. The landmark hotel offers 606 well-appointed guest rooms and suites, three distinctive restaurants, a health club and easy access to the city’s most popular attractions. jobs.description:
About Mashgin

Mashgin powers the world's best checkout experience for over 40 million users. Customers just place their items on our kiosks and our AI rings up their entire order in less than a second. With Mashgin, lines are now optional.

Mashgin's technology powers over 1 billion transactions at your favorite locations, including over half of all US professional sports teams, 4,000 convenience stores, major airports, universities, and more.

We’re not just building cutting-edge AI—we’re creating real-world impact and unforgettable experiences. Backed by a well-funded Series B, we’re also one of the rare AI startups that’s already profitable.

Our secret? A culture of extreme ownership, autonomy, and customer obsession. At Mashgin, we are building something extraordinary by challenging conventional wisdom. We’ve thrown out the old rules to focus on what truly matters: creating a kickass product that makes people say, 'Wow'. We don’t care about short-term wins; we build systems that stand the test of time. If you thrive in a culture of excellence without compromise and want to see your work have an immediate, remarkable impact, you’re in the right place.

We're hiring a Hardware Operations Program Manager to link our design engineers with our manufacturing partners. You'll keep the BOM accurate, run engineering changes through PLM, plan materials for new builds and mass production, and make sure finished kiosks are ready when customers need them. You will work closely with the hardware team to keep inventory, shipments, parts, and operational tasks organized and moving.

You don't need to be hands-on in every area, but you need to understand all of them well enough to spot risks early and drive decisions. What matters most is that you are organized, reliable, able to follow through, comfortable working with physical hardware, and eager to learn.

Location: Hybrid, San Jose, CA (onsite at least 2 days per week)

### **What We Value:**

* **Impact**: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
* **Simplicity**: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
* **Hard Work**: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
* **Humility**: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
* **Ruthless Prioritization**: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
* **Customer Innovation**: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
* **Efficiency**: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the BOM. Maintain accurate, multi-level BOMs for our kiosk products, tracking costs, lead times, single-source parts, and alternates.
* Assist with engineering changes in PLM. Manage ECO/ECN workflows with design engineers, ensuring changes are reviewed, released to our manufacturing partner, and phased in cleanly—including decisions about existing inventory.
* Assist with NPI builds. Plan and coordinate EVT, DVT, and PVT builds with engineering and our contract manufacturer. Track build issues through resolution and help take products into mass production.
* Plan materials for NPI and MP. Ensure parts arrive on time for prototype builds. For mass production, work from forecasts, manage long-lead-time parts, and balance shortages against excess inventory.
* Help manage international suppliers and manufacturing. Serve as the day-to-day contact for overseas suppliers and our contract manufacturer. Follow up on schedules, quality issues, pricing, and lead times.
* Track finished goods and inventory. Know how many units we have, where they are, and when we need to build more. Partner with finance to ensure inventory accuracy.
* Be the escalation point for logistics. Our fulfillment and shipping partners handle daily operations; step in when a shipment issue threatens a build or customer deployment.
* Keep everyone informed. Share clear updates on status, risks, and next steps with engineering, operations, finance, and leadership.
* Keep inventory records and shipment tracking information accurate and up to date.
* Support U.S. domestic logistics, including preparing shipments, coordinating with carriers, tracking deliveries, and helping resolve shipping issues.
* Follow up with our contract manufacturer, suppliers, and internal teams on open operational items.
* Help organize hardware, spare parts, packaging materials, and finished goods.
* Flag inventory discrepancies, shipment delays, and other issues to the team early.
* Support day-to-day hardware operations as priorities change.
* Maintain clear records so the team can see the latest status without having to reconstruct what happened.

### **What you bring**

* Minimum of 3 years in hardware operations, NPI program management, materials management, or a related role at a hardware company
* Working knowledge of multi-level (layered) BOMs and how changes ripple through them
* Hands-on experience with a PLM system such as Arena, Agile, Windchill, or Teamcenter, including ECO/ECN processes
* Experience working with design engineers to release at least one product to market
* Experience managing materials for NPI builds and/or mass production
* Broad understanding of manufacturing, ideally with international contract manufacturers
* Working knowledge of finished goods and inventory manag

jobs.title: Sr. New Product Technology Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high-velocity team of multi-disciplinary experts to turn real-world operations into high-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real-world, long-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match.  
  
As the Sr. New Product Technology Program Manager, you will own NPI build planning and readiness for the hardware technologies powering Uber AV Labs’ data-collection platforms. Your scope will span advanced sensing systems, embedded compute, data storage, wiring harnesses, and vehicle integration assemblies—from early engineering prototypes through pilot builds and transition to fleet deployment.  
  
You will translate evolving engineering requirements into executable build plans, aligning hardware configurations, component availability, supplier deliverables, logistics, and development budgets. Working across engineering, sourcing, finance, materials operations, and external build partners, you will identify risks early, resolve constraints, and ensure each development build has the right hardware, documentation, and resources to deliver meaningful engineering results.  
  
**Core Responsibilities**  

* **Own NPI Build Planning & Execution:** Develop and maintain integrated plans for prototype and pilot builds across components, subsystems, and complete vehicle platforms. Manage build matrices defining quantities, hardware revisions, configurations, destinations, and engineering objectives. Align milestones with design releases, supplier schedules, integration activities, and validation needs.
* **Drive Material Forecasting & Clear-to-Build Readiness:** Translate build requirements and engineering changes into time-phased material demand. Partner with sourcing, suppliers, and materials operations to assess part-level availability, lead times, allocation, and delivery commitments. Own consolidated Clear-to-Build (CTB) reporting, identify gaps, and drive recovery plans before they affect build milestones.
* **Lead BOM & Configuration Management:** Partner with engineering to structure and release Bills of Materials (BOMs), part numbers, drawings, and supporting documentation. Coordinate Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), revision effectiveness, and approved substitutions so suppliers and build partners execute against the correct configuration. Maintain traceability between planned configurations, as-built hardware, and validation results.
* **Manage Supplier & Build Partner Readiness:** Coordinate component vendors, technology suppliers, and vehicle upfitters to align deliverables with engineering build requirements. Track prototype fabrication, assembly readiness, tooling needs, component acceptance, and shipment commitments. Partner with sourcing on supplier escalations and drive resolution of schedule, quality, and capacity constraints.
* **Own Development Budget & Procurement Planning:** Build and maintain program-level forecasts for prototype hardware, tooling, non-recurring engineering, external build services, and logistics. Partner with engineering, sourcing, and finance to coordinate purchasing approvals, track commitments and spending, and communicate the cost implications of build changes.
* **Coordinate Build Logistics & Engineering Handoffs:** Align delivery plans, receiving readiness, hardware allocation, and build-site requirements with materials and logistics teams. Establish readiness reviews, decision deadlines, and escalation paths. Give leadership clear visibility into build status, material exposure, budget variance, and technical trade-offs, with actionable recommendations.
* **Establish Scalable NPI Processes & Tools:** Define practical workflows for build requests, demand forecasting, configuration control, and readiness reporting. Partner with engineering and operations teams to improve PLM and material-tracking tools, reduce manual reconciliation, and carry lessons from prototype builds into repeatable fleet deployment processes.

* **Relevant Experience:** 7+ years of experience in hardware NPI, engineering program management, supply chain program management, or a related discipline, including ownership of complex development builds involving internal engineering teams and external suppliers or manufacturing partners.
* **Technical Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree in engineering, supply chain, operations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Build Planning & Material Readiness:** Demonstrated experience managing build matrices, component forecasts, CTB analysis, supplier lead times, and shortage recovery plans for prototype or pilot hardware programs.
* **BOM & Configuration Management:** Practical experience with BOM structures, part-number creation, engineering releases, revision control, and ECO execution using PLM or related systems.
* **Supplier, Procurement & Budget Coordination:** Experience aligning supplier deliverables with engineering schedules and partnering with sourcing and finance on development purchasing, cost forecasts, and budget tracking.
* **Analytical & Communication Skills:** Strong spreadsheet and program-tracking skills, with the ability to turn detailed build and mate

**About the Role**
------------------

The **Program Manager, Clinical Trials** will run the day-to-day work of every agentic AI clinical trial we conduct, across **pre-trial, active trial, and post-trial** phases. You will work with internal clinical, research, regulatory, and engineering teams, and serve as the main operational contact for CROs and health system partners. You will be accountable for the success of each clinical program.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Pre-Trial**

* Work with clinical and research leads on study design, protocols, endpoints, and data collection strategy, including CRFs, EDC, and AI agent interaction data.
* Select and manage CROs and vendors: scopes of work, budgets, and contracts.
* Engage health system partners on site feasibility, contracting, and study startup.
* Coordinate IRB submissions, informed consent, data use agreements, and HIPAA reviews.
* Build integrated study plans covering timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risks.

### **During Trial**

* Manage daily trial operations across sites, CROs, and internal teams so studies stay on schedule, on budget, and on protocol.
* Track enrollment, retention, site performance, and data quality. Resolve issues as they arise.
* Coordinate trial logistics, including AI agent deployment with engineering, site training, and study materials.
* Make sure adverse events and AI-related safety escalations are tracked and reported according to protocol.
* Report progress, risks, and needed decisions to leadership.

### **Post-Trial**

* Lead close-out activities: database lock, site close-out, and vendor reconciliation.
* Support clinical study reports, regulatory submissions (e.g., FDA 510(k) or De Novo), and publications.
* Improve SOPs and playbooks so clinical operations can scale across a growing portfolio.

**Why we're hiring**
--------------------

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage. Our product is the operating system our own teams run on: voice AI intake, placements, instant quoting, sales, service and retention, plus the operator tools that tie them together. Each module has engineers, a forward-deployed pod and operators who live in it every day, but not enough product ownership to decide what to build, measure whether it worked, and keep the module coherent as it scales. This hire closes that gap. Each PM becomes the single owner of a module's outcomes: its KPIs, its roadmap and the operator experience inside it.

**Experience:** 5–8 years. **Scope:** Service (Customer Success)  
  
**About the role**

You own a product area that spans more than one team and more than one quarter. Nobody hands you the problem list; you find the problems worth solving, decide which to bet on, and are accountable for the outcome even when the work runs through several pods.

Service is the clearest example. It touches endorsements, certificates, renewals, billing and claims support, and today a lot of it runs on human effort. The Senior PM decides what gets productized, what stays operator-owned, and in what order.

### **What you'll own**

* **Outcomes, not features.** Propose the KPI set for your area and defend why those are the right targets. At least one should trace to a company top-line number (revenue, retention, cost per policy).
* **A 3–6 month roadmap** with clear bets, sequencing and kill criteria.
* **Growth avenues.** Look past optimizing today's funnel: new segments, use cases, or ways to expand revenue per account.
* **Cross-team delivery.** Break initiatives into plans other people can execute; chase dependencies directly; re-plan out loud the moment reality changes.
* **Ops partnership.** Be embedded enough that operators treat you as a peer on process. Turn recurring operational pain into bets with clear ROI.
* **Raising the bar.** Mentor the PM on specs and prioritization; own a stage of the PM interview loop.

  **Logistics**
  -------------

  + **Compensation:** $125,000–$170,000 base + performance bonus + equity.
  + **Location:** San Francisco, in-office. Based here or willing to relocate.
  + **Benefits:** Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks and coffee stocked; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision.

  **To apply:** Commercial insurance has never been rebuilt, and the gap between what frontier models make possible and what's actually shipped in this industry is the largest it will ever be. If you want to own a module that touches real customers from week one — send your resume and tell us about something you built that moved a number.

Compensation Range: $125K - $170K

jobs.title: Technical Customer Experience Lead
jobs.description:
**About Hark**

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

**About the Team**

You'll be the first person our users meet when something matters, and the person who makes sure it never happens twice. As our Technical Customer Experience Lead, you own every customer's success with Hark across our app, our agent, and our devices. You'll solve the hard cases yourself, then use AI and AI coding agents to build the systems that solve the next thousand automatically. You'll sit close to engineering and product, and what you learn from customers will shape what we ship. This is a founding role: you'll define how Hark takes care of people, and eventually build the team that does it.

**Responsibilities**

* **Own customer outcomes end to end.** Work directly with users, get to the real root cause, and leave them better off than when they reached out.
* **Build AI-powered customer systems.** Design the triage, routing, drafting, knowledge retrieval, and automated resolution that make every answer faster and better than the last.
* **Ship your own tools.** Use AI coding agents to build the scripts, integrations, dashboards, and workflows behind customer success, without waiting on engineering.
* **Be the technical bridge to engineering.** Reproduce bugs, read logs, and hand engineering clear, actionable reports.
* **Turn signal into product.** Spot patterns across customer conversations and turn them into product feedback, help center content, and fixes that prevent the next issue.
* **Own the numbers.** Response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, with a constant loop to improve them.
* **Build the function.** The playbook, tooling, escalation paths, and eventually the team, as Hark scales.

**Requirements**

* **Customer Experience:** 1–5 years in customer experience, customer support, or support operations, ideally at a consumer tech or software company, with hands-on customer work.
* **Genuine Care for Customers:** You care about the person on the other side and take pride in getting them to a real answer.
* **AI-First Mindset:** You use AI to raise the quality and speed of how you help customers, and you can point to ways you've already done it.
* **Comfort with AI Coding Agents:** You build what you need with AI coding tools, whether that's a script, an integration, or an internal tool.
* **Technical Depth:** You troubleshoot software issues, read logs, and explain technical problems clearly to both users and engineers.
* **Strong Communication:** Your writing is clear, warm, and precise, and you adjust your tone for a frustrated customer, an engineer, or a leadership update.

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience building or scaling a customer function at an early-stage startup.
* Experience supporting consumer software and hardware products.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk, Intercom, or Front, and their APIs.
* Experience with AI or LLM-powered products.

**Compensation**

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $120,000 - $170,000 annually.

The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components and benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended.

jobs.description:
**Work That Fits Your Life**

* **Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S.** We're headquartered in Chicago, but your office is wherever you do your best work.
* **A four-day workweek.** Work-life balance is built into our business, with a full-time, 32-hour week over four days.

* **Benefits for you and your family.** We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company matching, and 12 weeks of paid new parent leave.

**What Sets Us Apart: We Value Every Job**

You don't have to be a scientist to be part of the science. Every job here, from sales and marketing to product and engineering, helps turn that science into better talent insights for our customers.

* **Our Mission.** Wonderlic's mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job.
* **Scientific Excellence.** We pair nearly 90 years of assessment science with industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology, machine learning, and AI.
* **What Our Work Makes Possible.** Our tools help HR teams spot great candidates, see who's most likely to succeed on the job, develop their people, and build stronger teams.
* **We Practice What We Sell.** We help companies hire and develop the right people, and we use the same approach to build and grow our own team. You're hired for your potential, and we help you develop it.

**Overview**

Wonderlic is looking for a commercially minded Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) who builds strategic partnerships with clients. We're on a mission to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job. This job is more than managing client relationships. You'll be a trusted advisor to our most complex clients, bringing them the right resources, from talent and services to products, to help them reach their business goals. That partnership drives renewals, expansion, and long-term growth.

**Your Impact**

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you'll drive revenue growth by helping clients get real results from Wonderlic. You'll use your business acumen and experience across talent management to manage a portfolio of clients, building strong relationships and acting as a trusted advisor. Your ability to understand complex client needs and connect our platform and services to their strategic goals will be key to winning renewals and expansion.

**What You'll Do**

* **Drive Growth and Retention.**
  + Proactively identify opportunities across your client portfolio to drive renewals and expansion, meeting and exceeding revenue targets.
  + Build strong client relationships through strategic conversations that connect Wonderlic to each client's business objectives.

* **Bring the Right Resources.**
  + Maintain deep knowledge of our products, services, industry trends, and competitive landscape to offer strategic insights and recommendations.
  + Introduce new products, features, and services that help clients reach their business outcomes.
* **Advocate for Clients.**
  + Act as the client's advocate within Wonderlic, improving the client experience to strengthen retention.
  + Create feedback loops between clients and product teams to identify and remove barriers to adoption.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Proven Success.** Recognized for exceptional commercial achievements and consistently exceeding targets, especially in formalized recognition programs.
* **Consistent Excellence.** A strong track record of meeting and surpassing expectations.
* **Stability and Growth.** Demonstrated ability to achieve long-term success and growth in previous jobs.

* **Industry Knowledge.** Deep understanding of the challenges clients face across talent management, from hiring through development and retention.
* **Trusted Advisor.** Experience guiding complex clients toward their business outcomes, because you care about the client experience and know it drives long-term retention and growth.
* Recognized subject matter expert with experience coaching or mentoring others.
* **Curiosity and Creativity.** Naturally curious and creative in your approach to solving problems.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Customer Success or Account Management experience, with real experience working with stakeholders across talent management. SaaS experience is preferred.
* Proven track record of managing a portfolio of accounts, securing renewals, and driving revenue growth through cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
* Strong business acumen, with excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills with decision-makers across talent management.
* Analytical skills and the ability to use data to guide client conversations and uncover opportunities.
* Proactive and collaborative mindset, with the flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**Compensation**

This position offers OTE of $110,000 to $140,000, split between a base salary and variable compensation.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Accord Financial Solutions**

Accord Financial Solutions provides tax-time financial products, including refund transfers and refund advances, through participating tax preparation offices.

We’re launching a new program for the 2027 tax filing season and building a dedicated Customer Support team to serve our growing network of tax offices and their customers.

Joining Accord means becoming part of a new team where your contributions will help shape how we serve our customers.

About the Role:

We’re looking for detail-oriented, customer-focused Customer Support Specialists who enjoy helping people and solving problems.

In this role, you’ll assist tax offices and taxpayers by phone and email, support enrollment and application reviews, and ensure customer inquiries are documented and resolved efficiently.

You’ll receive training on Accord’s products, processes, and systems and have opportunities to expand your knowledge as the program grows.

Key Responsibilities

* Respond to inbound phone calls and emails from tax offices and taxpayers regarding enrollment, refund transfers, refund advances, and funding status.
* Conduct outbound welcome calls and follow up on incomplete applications or missing documentation.
* Assist with tax office application reviews, including identification documents, EFIN verification, business registration checks, and screening results.
* Maintain accurate case records, notes, and documentation in Accord’s customer support system.
* Identify and escalate customer complaints, suspected fraud, identity theft concerns, and complex inquiries.
* Follow established operating procedures, privacy standards, and compliance requirements.
* Participate in cross-training and support the future expansion into tax software and service bureau support.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required:

* At least 1 year of customer service, customer support, or call center experience.
* Strong telephone communication and customer service skills.
* Clear, professional written communication.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established procedures.
* Comfortable using computer systems, CRM platforms, and cloud-based phone technology.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple customer requests.
* Availability for extended hours, including evenings, during peak tax season.
* Ability to successfully complete a background check and required BSA/AML training.

Preferred:

* Experience in tax preparation, refund transfers, refund advances, or tax software.
* Experience in banking, fintech, or financial services.
* Familiarity with underwriting, KYC, document review, or financial compliance.
* Spanish-English bilingual communication skills.

Work Environment & Schedule

This is a fully remote position, and company equipment will be provided. Core support hours are weekdays, Eastern Time, with expanded hours during peak tax season and as the program grows.

Team members will receive cross-training and may assist with additional customer support functions as business needs evolve.

The Instructional Designer is responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing engaging, student-centered online and hybrid courses across multiple institutions. This position applies instructional design principles, adult learning theory, and evidence-based teaching practices to create effective learning experiences that support student success and achievement of learning outcomes.

The Instructional Designer collaborates with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), academic leadership, and cross-functional teams to develop high-quality courses that align course learning outcomes with program learning outcomes, institutional curriculum requirements, academic standards, and established course development processes. This position incorporates appropriate instructional technologies, accessible learning materials, interactive activities, and authentic assessments to support diverse learners and promote meaningful learning experiences.

* Apply authentic assessment strategies that encourage students to demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competencies through meaningful applications.
* Review and map instructional content, textbooks, and proprietary and third-party learning resources to course outcomes and module objectives.
* Support the integration of instructional strategies and assessments that promote continuous improvement in teaching and learning.

**Collaboration and Project Management**
========================================

* Partner with SMEs, academic leadership, and other stakeholders throughout the course design and development process to ensure instructional quality and curriculum alignment.
* Manage multiple course development and revision projects simultaneously while meeting established timelines, project milestones, and course launch deadlines.

**Instructional Technology and Accessibility**
==============================================

* Stay informed of current research, emerging technologies, and best practices in instructional design, online learning, and higher education.

* Proficiency with learning management systems, eLearning authoring tools, Microsoft 365 applications, and other instructional technologies.
* Knowledge of emerging educational technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) applications, and their appropriate use in instructional design and online learning.
* Ability to evaluate and integrate multimedia, interactive learning activities, and emerging instructional technologies to enhance the online learning experience.
* Strong project management and organizational

jobs.title: Regional Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Regional Operations Manager leads the performance of a group of manufactured housing communities. The role coaches Community Managers, protects resident satisfaction and property standards, and delivers occupancy, revenue, expense, and sales results for the region.

This is a new regional seat on the Operations team, released from hold. The assigned region will be confirmed at hiring.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Operational Leadership**

* Supervise, coach, and evaluate Community Managers and on-site teams across the region.
* Conduct regular property visits and inspections to confirm curb appeal, safety, maintenance, and resident service standards.
* Oversee lot and home inventory, home readiness, and turn times, and drive each community toward full occupancy.
* Oversee vendor performance, capital and infrastructure projects, and emergency and severe weather readiness.

**Financial Performance**

* Prepare annual community operating budgets with Community Managers and the finance team, building the occupancy, rent, sales, expense, and capital assumptions for each community; recommend final budgets for approval; and manage variances to budget.
* Monitor rent collection and delinquency and direct payment plans, notices, and evictions in coordination with company counsel.
* Review monthly financial statements with Community Managers and drive corrective action.
* Set and track monthly sales, leasing, and occupancy targets for each community.

**People and Culture**

* Participate in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training of on-site staff in partnership with Human Resources.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and resident-centered service.
* Document performance concerns and coordinate corrective action with Human Resources.

**Compliance and Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with Fair Housing, landlord-tenant, ADA, and state and local regulations.
* Confirm licenses, permits, registrations, and inspections are current for each community.
* Report incidents, injuries, and property damage promptly and prepare regional reports for the VP of Operations.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
* Five or more years of property management experience, including multi-site oversight, required. Manufactured housing experience strongly preferred.
* Experience supervising managers, including hiring, coaching, and documenting performance, required.
* CPM, CAM, MCM, or similar certification is a plus.
* Demonstrated sales or leasing results, including meeting a quota, preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and coaching skills.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, delinquency management, and expense control.
* Knowledge of property management software such as Yardi, Rent Manager, or AppFolio.
* Working knowledge of Fair Housing laws and landlord-tenant regulations in the states served.
* Ability to manage multiple sites and priorities.
* Willingness to hold difficult conversations, including delinquency, rule violations, and employment decisions.

**Requirements**

* Valid driver license and reliable transportation. Must meet company insurability standards and a motor vehicle record check is required.
* Employment is contingent on satisfactory completion of a background screening.
* Must complete company-required Fair Housing, safety, and anti-harassment training as assigned.
* Regular overnight travel within the region and availability for emergencies after hours.

**Physical Requirements & Working Conditions**

* Ability to walk properties and inspect homes and lots regularly.
* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.
* Work is performed in communities, in vehicles, and in an office, in varying weather conditions.
* Standard hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday, with flexibility for site needs.

**COMPENSATION, BENEFITS:**

* Position type: full-time, salaried, exempt.
* Pay: base salary based on experience and qualifications.
* Annual bonus target of 10 percent of base, based on regional results.
* Benefits: medical, dental, and vision; paid time off; paid holidays; and retirement plan.

**COMPANY:**

Everabode Property Management LLC (EPM) is a newly established property management company focused on operating and enhancing manufactured housing communities across multiple states. Backed by a longstanding real estate firm with deep expertise in the manufactured housing industry, we offer both the entrepreneurial excitement of building a company from the ground up and the stability of experienced industry leadership.

At EPM, we are committed to:

* Resident-Centered Service – creating communities where residents feel valued and supported.
* Operational Excellence – ensuring efficiency, compliance, and high performance across our portfolio.
* Growth & Innovation – expanding our footprint while modernizing community management.

*Joining EPM means helping shape our culture and future success during this foundational phase. It’s a unique opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility, grow your career, and play a central role in building something new, with the resources and backing of a proven leader in the manufactured housing industry.*

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & DISCLOSURES:**

Everabode Property Management LLC is an equal opportunity employer. EPM does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

EPM complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable state law and provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application process and in employment.

Our mission is to radically transform healthcare by harnessing the power of artificial intelligence and clinical expertise to make care more affordable, accessible, and effective for everyone.

Lead Product Managers at Curai are force multipliers who tackle our most consequential product problems, shape product direction, and elevate the organization around them.

As Lead Product Manager, Activation, you'll own the first-use product experience, from the user's first message through clinical handoff, across direct-to-consumer and partner channels. You'll identify and remove barriers to conversion, improve how users discover and engage with non-clinical services, and shape new opportunities to help people get the care and support they need.

* Partner with Product leadership to increase quality and velocity.

### **What you’ll need**

Critical Facility Group (CFG) is an MEP consulting and owner's project management firm specializing in data centers and mission-critical facilities. Remote (US)

* Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to lead and coordinate distributed, multidisciplinary teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

We're a growing team of engineers and project leaders focused on data centers and mission-critical facilities. jobs.title: Innovation and Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

Working under the direction of the assigned Pod Lead or Implementation Lead, the Specialist provides hands-on research, analysis, coordination, and implementation support across concurrent DRHCI initiatives. The Innovation and Implementation Specialist carries the business case for each assigned project from its start to its transition. At the front end, market research that validates the problem and establishes the project charter; at the back end, develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard, updated market research, analysis of alternatives, and budget estimates that a project needs to transition to the Digital Health Office for enterprise scaling.  
The role contributes throughout the innovation lifecycle from understanding the problem and assessing local readiness to supporting pilots, gathering feedback, refining implementation approaches, and preparing resources for continued use. The Specialist applies sound judgment to assess information, identify gaps, and recommend practical solutions appropriate to the intended users and implementation setting.  
For assigned business-process activities, the Specialist carries forward the evidence and assumptions supporting a project’s business case from initial problem validation through pilot results and consideration for enterprise scaling. The role coordinates market research, project charters, value scorecards, and resource estimates, drawing on the data and evaluation team for measurement methodology and validated outcome data.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Supports market research for assigned projects, partnering with innovators to complete the Market Research Guide validating the problem, quantifying scope and impact, and assessing the market landscape to determine best value for VA.
* Coordinates creation of Project Charters outlining scope, resources, roles, and responsibilities to authorize and structure each assigned project.
* Develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard for assigned projects transitioning to DHO, including measured impact against baseline and validated cost savings and ROI supported by evidence.
* Summarizes lessons learned, changes to assumptions, and unintended consequences for assigned projects.
* Socializes the business case with DHO and relevant local and national parties, gathering feedback and adapting scope as necessary.
* Updates market research to account for new analyses of alternatives and projected demand within VA as a project matures.
* Reassesses resource and funding needs for scaling, including additional costs for communications, training, and evaluation support, and produces budget estimate reporting.
* Contributes to the shared tracking system with DHO monitoring projects in transition and those accepted into the scaling pipeline.
* Works with the Data & Evaluation Lead to ensure the metrics and baselines committed at charter are the ones the business case will need at the end. Supports coordination meetings with DHO and relevant program offices to review scaling pipeline candidates and align priorities.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively, maintain accurate status information, and communicate barriers early.  
The role may coordinate working sessions and contributions from multiple stakeholders. Decisions involving clinical practice, technology configuration, security authorization, procurement, resource commitments, or changes in scope are elevated to the appropriate authorized personnel.  
For business-process assignments, the Specialist works with the assigned innovation pod lead and designated data and evaluation personnel to maintain consistency between project assumptions, measurement methods, validated results, and scaling recommendations. Approval of project charters, funding commitments, procurement approaches, and enterprise scaling remains with authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five or more years in business analysis, program analysis, or management consulting involving business case development.
* Demonstrated experience conducting market research or analysis of alternatives to support a build, buy, or reuse decision.
* Experience developing a business case with cost and benefit analysis that a skeptical reviewer accepted.
* Experience producing project charters and structuring project scope, roles, and responsibilities.
