jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**If you’re the person people turn to when a technical problem gets messy and nobody is sure what happens next, we’d like to meet you.**

At CustomCommerce, we build custom software, AI agents, and automations that help businesses solve practical problems. We build in short, iterative cycles so clients can see progress and shape the solution along the way. Weekly demos give clients a chance to see what’s ready, test improvements in their day-to-day workflows, and tell us what needs refining. This iterative approach delivers usable capabilities sooner, helps us refine solutions around how clients actually work, and keeps their investment focused on the priorities that create the most value for their business.

We are looking for someone who can make that process work well for everyone. You might start the day helping a client explain why an AI agent is routing inquiries incorrectly, then turn that conversation into a clear issue engineering can investigate. Later, you might walk another client through a demo and get a decision that keeps their project moving. The common thread is bringing clarity to technical work and making sure people follow through. If you enjoy solving problems and want to help shape how solutions work in practice, this role gives you room to do that.

**The Role**

Once a deal is signed, you will become the client’s primary point of contact. You will lead the handoff from sales, connect the client with engineering through development, testing, and launch, and stay involved afterward to support adoption and resolve issues.

You will manage execution against the agreed project plan. You will keep deliverables moving, coordinate client decisions and approvals, and flag risks early. Engineering owns technical estimates and decisions about how the solution is built. When a client asks for work outside the agreed scope, you will clarify what they need, bring in leadership to assess the request, and keep the client informed about next steps.

**What You will Do**

* **Make the handoff from sales feel seamless.** Get up to speed on what was sold, why the client needs it, and what success looks like. Confirm expectations and immediate next steps at kickoff.
* **Keep multiple projects moving.** Track deliverables, deadlines, dependencies, and commitments on both sides. Follow up on open items and bring in the right people when a milestone is at risk.
* **Give clients a clear view of progress.** Run check-ins and send clear updates so clients know what’s ready, what’s in progress, and where their input or approval is needed.
* **Use weekly demos to turn client feedback into clear next steps.** Help clients prepare to test what’s ready, capture feedback and decisions during demos, and bring unresolved questions, client priorities, and dependencies into monthly planning.
* **Turn client feedback into work engineering can act on.** Ask questions to understand what the client is trying to accomplish. Document the workflow, expected behavior, and how the client will confirm the solution meets their needs.
* **Investigate issues and follow through.** Gather examples, reproduce the problem when possible, and check whether it stems from how the solution is used, configured, or behaving. Give engineering enough context to investigate and keep the client updated through resolution.
* **Coordinate testing and launch.** Help clients test real scenarios, track fixes and approvals, and confirm they’re ready to use the solution in their day-to-day work.
* **Help deliver client value after launch.** Help clients get comfortable with the solution, coordinate ongoing support, and surface opportunities for follow-on work when they reflect a real business need.

**What You Bring**

* **Clear written and verbal communication.** You can lead a client call, explain a technical issue in plain language, and write a recap that makes decisions and next steps easy to find.
* **Strong organization across competing priorities.** You can manage several active client engagements and keep track of who owns each next step, when it’s due, and what’s at risk.
* **Technical curiosity and practical troubleshooting skills.** You ask focused questions, test possible causes, and know when to bring in a specialist. You don’t need to write code.
* **Good judgment when things change.** You can handle a frustrated client, an unclear request, or a slipping deliverable calmly. You set realistic expectations and follow through.
* **Experience helping customers or business users solve technical problems.** Technical support, help desk, business analysis, software implementation, and other hands-on technology roles are all relevant. If you’ve been the person who keeps users informed, brings the right people together, and sees issues through, we’d like to hear from you. A previous Customer Success Manager title isn’t required.

**Experience That Would Be a Plus**

* A strong interest in AI or hands-on experience experimenting with AI agents, AI tools, or workflow automation. Personal projects count, too.
* Experience supporting custom software, SaaS products, integrations, or technology implementations.
* Experience gathering requirements, documenting workflows, coordinating user testing, or helping teams adopt a new system.

Pay: $50,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

**Work That Fits Your Life**

* **Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S.** We're headquartered in Chicago, but your office is wherever you do your best work.
* **A four-day workweek.** Work-life balance is built into our business, with a full-time, 32-hour week over four days.
* **Time to recharge.** You'll get generous PTO, paid holidays, and a paid company shutdown from December 24 through January 1.
* **Benefits for you and your family.** We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company matching, and 12 weeks of paid new parent leave.

**What Sets Us Apart: We Value Every Job**

You don't have to be a scientist to be part of the science. Every job here, from sales and marketing to product and engineering, helps turn that science into better talent insights for our customers.

* **Our Mission.** Wonderlic's mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job.
* **Scientific Excellence.** We pair nearly 90 years of assessment science with industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology, machine learning, and AI.
* **What Our Work Makes Possible.** Our tools help HR teams spot great candidates, see who's most likely to succeed on the job, develop their people, and build stronger teams.

**Overview:**
-------------

Wonderlic is seeking a **Senior Account Manager, Talent Development Solutions** to drive revenue growth within our existing customer base. This role is responsible for creating and closing cross-sell and expansion opportunities, with a primary focus on expanding cross-sell of Wonderlic Develop. We are building a revenue engine grounded in value-based selling—where every conversation connects talent decisions to measurable business outcomes such as performance, retention, and productivity.

This is **not a renewal role, it is a quota carrying sales role**—you will partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), who own retention and account health, while you focus on identifying, creating, and closing new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.

This role requires the mindset and skillset of a top-performing Sales Account Executive, applied within an existing customer base. You will operate as a strategic seller inside the install base, bringing a strong point of view on how customers can solve critical business challenges related to hiring, development, and workforce performance.

**Your Impact:**
----------------

As a Senior Account Manager, Talent Development Solutions, you will drive measurable revenue growth within our existing customer base by identifying, creating, and closing cross-sell opportunities. You will turn existing relationships into strategic growth engines—expanding adoption of Wonderlic solutions by connecting talent decisions to business outcomes such as retention, performance, and productivity. Your success will directly impact net revenue retention, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* **Pipeline Creation:** Proactively prospect into existing accounts across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. Identify new stakeholders, departments, and use cases within existing accounts to uncover cross-sell opportunities. Leverage internal signals (product usage, hiring trends, organizational changes) to trigger expansion plays. Generate pipeline independent of Customer Success; Customer Success is a strategic partner, not the primary source of opportunities.
* **Value-Based Selling & Opportunity Creation:** Lead strategic discovery conversations that uncover organizational pain and quantify business impact. Connect customer challenges to measurable outcomes (e.g., turnover cost, productivity gaps, time-to-performance). Align solutions to broader business objectives and executive-level key performance indicators. Position Wonderlic solutions using a value-based approach—avoiding feature-led selling.
* **Sales Cycle Management:** Manage opportunities through the sales cycle from discovery and solution alignment to business case and close, while navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups (Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Executives, and others). Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce.

* **Market Insight:** Maintain strong knowledge of new and existing product offerings, industry trends, new developments, and current competitive conditions within the marketplace.
* **Bring Strategic Insights:** Leverage your curiosity about our products, industry, and the marketplace to build and maintain strong knowledge, enabling you to offer strategic insights and solutions to our customers.

**What Success Looks Like:**
----------------------------

* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion quota
* Maintain 3–5x pipeline coverage driven by self-sourced opportunities
* Demonstrate strong conversion from discovery to close
* Lead executive conversations that elevate from product to business impact
* Expand relationships across multiple stakeholders and functions
* Operate in tight alignment with Customer Success while maintaining clear ownership of revenue outcomes

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

#### **Skills & Capabilities**

* Exceptional discovery skills—ability to uncover and monetize customer pain
* Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders
* Skilled in negotiation and closing
* Ability to manage complex, multi-threaded deals

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning Transformation Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

 **Job Description**

The E2E Planning Transformation Functional Program Manager is the program execution anchor for Western Digital's supply chain planning transformation portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President of Supply Chain Planning, this role drives cross-functional program management across the full suite of strategic transformation initiatives — from Kinaxis RapidResponse enablement and S&OP process redesign to LRP automation and Capital planning improvements. You design and own the Management Operating Structure of Supply Chain Planning & Capital group: initiative delivery, operational review infrastructure, business value realization, and organizational health tracking — not just status reporting.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

1. Operational Review Infrastructure

Enable and organize the operational review cadence that feeds into key executive reviews — including Quarterly Business Reviews, annual planning cycles, and transformation portfolio reviews. Own the structure, preparation, content quality, and follow-through for each review gate so leadership always has a decision-ready view of the business.

2. Balanced Scorecard Creation & Operationalization

Help structure and operationalize a Balanced Scorecard for Supply Chain Planning and Capital — defining the right metrics across financial, operational, transformation, and talent dimensions. Translate executive intent into a living scorecard that is reviewed regularly and drives corrective action, not just reporting.

3. Transformation Portfolio Management

Own the program management of key supply chain planning transformation initiatives across WD's Planning and Capital functions. Define initiative charters, drive milestone accountability, track risks and interdependencies, and ensure each initiative is tied to a measurable business outcome — not just a project plan.

4. Interim Tools & Process Enhancements

Identify and drive interim solutions and near-term enhancements to planning tools and processes while longer-horizon transformation initiatives are underway. Bridge the gap between today's operational reality and tomorrow's target state — ensuring the planning team is not waiting on transformation to get better.

5. Leadership Initiative Tracking

Track leadership-directed initiatives from assignment through closure — maintaining a living tracker of open commitments, owners, due dates, and completion status. Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between leadership reviews, and surface at-risk items before they miss their window.

6. Headcount & Budget Tracking

Maintain visibility on transformation program headcount allocation and budget consumption across all initiatives. Track resource utilization, cost-to-complete, and variance to plan; escalate resource constraints and budget risks to leadership before they impact delivery. Own the monthly headcount and budget summary for the transformation portfolio.

7. Quarterly Transformation Newsletters

Create and distribute quarterly newsletters that communicate transformation progress, wins, and upcoming milestones to the broader Supply Chain Planning and Capital organization. Tell the story of what's changing, why it matters, and how each person fits into the transformation journey. Drive engagement and adoption through clear, consistent, outcome-focused communication.

8. Monthly Transformation Reviews

Own the monthly transformation review cadence — gathering status from initiative DRIs, synthesizing risks and blockers, tracking value realization, and preparing leadership with a clear decision-ready summary. Drive accountability for timeliness, accuracy, and forward-looking risk identification at each monthly touchpoint.

9. Business Process Owner Forum Coordination

Track and coordinate the Business Process Owner (BPO) forum — ensuring the right stakeholders are aligned on process changes, new system capabilities, and adoption requirements as transformation initiatives go live. Maintain the BPO community as the connection point between transformation teams and operational execution, surfacing adoption barriers and change management needs.

**What You Will Work On**

**Weekly: Transformation Ops Cadence**

Run the weekly transformation operating rhythm — initiative status reviews, leadership initiative tracker updates, blocker resolution, headcount/budget check-ins, and ops package inputs. Keep the portfolio moving without waiting for the monthly cycle.

**Monthly: Transformation Reviews & Scorecard Updates**

Own the monthly transformation review — gathering DRI updates, synthesizing risks, tracking value realization, updating the Balanced Scorecard, and monitoring headcount and budget consumption. Prepare leadership summary highlighting progress, risks, and resource status.

**Quarterly: QBRs, Portfolio Reviews & Newsletters**

Own preparation and execution of quarterly operational reviews and QBRs. Publish the quarterly transformation newsletter to the broader organization. Review portfolio health, resource allocation, and adoption momentum across all active initiatives.

**Ongoing: BPO Forum & Initiative Closure**

Track and facilitate the Business Process Owner (BPO) forum as the hub for process alignment and adoption coor

* Lead vegetation management operations, contractor performance, project teams, and emergency response efforts in compliance with safety regulations and labor agreements.

* Excellent communication and independent work skills
* Comfortable working in rugged terrain and varying weather conditions

new_jobs.description:
The ams OSRAM Group is a global leader in innovative light and sensor solutions. As a specialist in Digital Photonics, we combine technological excellence with state-of-the-art global manufacturing capabilities to offer our customers the broadest portfolio of digital emitter and sensor technologies. Globally, our teams develop groundbreaking solutions aligned with societal megatrends like intelligent mobility, artificial intelligence, augmented reality, smart health, and robotics.

At ams OSRAM, employees are part of a highly innovative, international technology environment. Diverse teams, a high degree of ownership, and exciting challenges provide the opportunity to grow, develop, and make a real difference. Because behind our innovations are people who carry something special inside and who bring their unique strengths to work every day.

Show the world what you are made of.

Your new responsibilities

We are seeking a highly experienced Strategic Account Manager to lead and grow a key customer relationship within our semiconductor sensor portfolio. This role requires deep familiarity with silicon-based semiconductor technologies, strong technical sales acumen, and proven success managing complex, high-value strategic accounts.

The ideal candidate will bring direct experience working with a top strategic customer, along with a strong background in sensor technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as one of the primary commercial interfaces between the customer and internal teams (engineering, product marketing, operations)
* Drive design wins, long-term programs, and revenue growth
* Develop and execute account strategies, including opportunity mapping, competitive positioning, and growth plans
* Partner closely with FAEs and engineering to support customer design-in activities
* Navigate complex customer organizations, including procurement, engineering, and executive leadership
* Manage pricing strategy, contract negotiations, forecasts, and demand planning
* Identify new applications and system-level opportunities for sensor solutions

What we look for

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.
* 8 plus years of experience in strategic account management, technical sales, or customer-facing roles within the semiconductor industry.
* Strong contract negotiation, legal communication, and executive presence skills, with the ability to influence at multiple levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated experience supporting and growing relationships with large, strategic customers, including managing complex, long-term engagements.
* Strong technical understanding of silicon-based semiconductor technologies, with direct exposure to sensor products preferred.
* Proven ability to translate technical concepts into business value for customers and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product management, operations, and supply chain teams.
* Comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment and managing competing priorities across regions.
* Travel: up to 25% as needed to support key customer engagements locally and internationally.

new_jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About AiDASH**  
  
AiDASH is leading the PreventionFirst™movement for electric utilities and transforming grid resilience through its pioneering platform that unifies vegetation, asset, storm, and wildfire intelligence. Powered by SatelliteFirst™ Inspection & Monitoring, AiDASH delivers comprehensive visibility across the entire grid at the right frequency and budget, using the right data modality. More than 200 customers trust AiDASH to keep the lights on, spend where it counts, and defend every decision, Securing Tomorrow across every mile of the grid. Learn more at www.aidash.com.

The PreventionFirst movement is growing, and so is the recognition behind it. In 2026, Forbes named AiDASH one of America's Best Startup Employers for the 4th consecutive year, and TIME included AiDASH among America's Top GreenTech Companies for the 3rd year in a row. Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ ranked AiDASH No. 12 in the San Francisco Bay Area, and No. 59 overall in their selection of the top 500 for 2024.

Join us in Securing Tomorrow Together!

**The Role**

As our Executive Assistant & Office Manager, you'll run our Palo Alto office and make it a welcoming, well-organized space where our team can do their best work. You'll oversee office operations, coordinate executive schedules and travel, and manage the administrative details that keep a growing global company running smoothly.

You'll work closely with our leadership team and partners across People & Culture, Finance, and Recruiting. This role calls for someone who is proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity; someone who anticipates needs, takes ownership, and builds structure and processes as the company evolves.

If you enjoy wearing multiple hats, solving problems independently, and creating great experiences for both employees and visitors, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact as we grow.

**How you'll make an impact:**

* **Office & Workplace Operations**
  + Own the day-to-day operations of our Palo Alto office, serving as the primary point of contact for vendors, facilities, and building management
  + Manage the daily lunch program, including vendor relationships, ordering, headcount, dietary requirements, and budget
  + Oversee office supplies, snacks, kitchen operations, and the upkeep of shared spaces
  + Manage incoming and outgoing mail, packages, and deliveries
  + Coordinate office access and badges, meeting room setups, and AV requirements
  + Welcome and assist visitors, customers, partners, and candidates
* **Executive & Business Support**
  + Coordinate calendars, meetings, and travel arrangements for members of the leadership team
  + Arrange catering and logistics for leadership meetings, interview loops, and customer or partner visits
  + Lead the planning and execution of company offsites and leadership retreats, including venue selection, hotel accommodations, agendas, and on-site logistics
* **Employee Experience, Recruiting Coordination & Culture**
  + Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities and celebrations, including birthdays, work anniversaries, company milestones, and holiday events
  + Coordinate workspace and equipment setup for new hires, ensuring a smooth and welcoming first-day experience
  + Partner with Recruiting to coordinate interview schedules and deliver a seamless candidate experience
* **Administrative & Financial Operations**
  + Process invoices, expense reports, and purchase requests in partnership with Finance
  + Coordinate agreements and documents for signature through Adobe Sign and maintain accurate, organized records
  + Support general administrative tasks and special projects as business needs evolve

**What we're looking for:**

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in office management, executive assistance, workplace operations, or a similar role, ideally within a high-growth startup
* 2 years of experience directly supporting senior executives, including calendar management, meeting coordination, travel planning, and handling competing priorities
* 2 years of independently managing office operations or facilities, including vendor relationships and budgets
* Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a polished and professional approach
* Sound judgment and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
* A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to anticipate needs, solve problems, and take initiative without waiting for direction
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and building processes in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace
* Ability to work on-site in Palo Alto (3 days a week) and occasionally flex working hours to support teams across time zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a global organization with teams across multiple countries
* Experience planning company events, offsites, and leadership retreats, including group travel logistics
* Familiarity with tools such as Greenhouse, Adobe Sign, Expensify, or similar platforms

**What you'll love:**

* **Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage:** 100% coverage for employees and 80% for their spouses and children
* **Health Reimbursement Account (HRA):** 100% funded by AiDASH to cover medical deductibles
* **401(k) Plan:** Begin contributing after two months of employment to prepare for your future. Currently, no company match is offered
* **Parental Leave:** Supportive parental leave with 16 weeks for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary caregivers
* **Generous Vacation Policy:** Accrue 20 vacation days per year, plus enjoy an additional flex holiday to celebrate whatever feels most important to you
* **Winter Break:** From December 25th through January 1st, we give everyone time off to recharge and enjoy

Bring your organizational skills, attention to detail, and interest in data and process improvement to FHLBank San Francisco.

As an Administrative Operations Coordinator supporting Credit and Collateral Risk Management (CCRM), you’ll help the department maintain accurate information, execute operational controls, and coordinate work across business and technology teams. Your responsibilities will combine advanced administrative support with reporting, process documentation, testing, and project coordination.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, keeping complex activities organized, and finding practical ways to improve how work gets done.

**What you’ll do**

  

* Support accurate data and reporting. Maintain departmental databases, business records, and customer profiles. Process membership and counterparty portfolio changes, reconcile information, and prepare recurring operational, credit agreement, control, and regulatory reports.
* Contribute to credit and collateral operations. Gather source data, maintain customer files, compile reporting inputs, and support analysts with risk monitoring, research distribution, and compliance activities.
* Document and improve processes. Maintain procedures, workflows, job aids, reporting tools, and process inventories. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and reduce manual work for process-owner review.
* Support system and operational changes. Help gather and document business requirements, coordinate stakeholder follow-up, and support user acceptance testing by recording results, tracking defects, and coordinating resolution.
* Coordinate departmental business activities. Support vendor requests, purchase requisitions, disbursements, expense tracking, records retention, and business unit onboarding.
* Support leadership and committee operations. Schedule meetings, prepare management and committee materials, coordinate Credit Committee and Credit Review Working Group attendance, track action items, and prepare minutes for review.
* Handle sensitive information with care. Maintain appropriate controls over confidential business records and regulatory materials in accordance with Bank policies and procedures.

**What you’ll bring**

  

* Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint or comparable collaboration tools.
* Strong Excel capabilities, including formulas, lookup functions, pivot tables, data validation, charts, and controlled spreadsheet design.
* Ability to compile, validate, reconcile, and analyze information from multiple sources, identify exceptions and trends, and communicate findings accurately.
* Ability to clearly document processes, controls, requirements, test scenarios, and implementation results.
* Working knowledge of data quality, reconciliation, exception management, process improvement, root-cause analysis, user acceptance testing, and change implementation.
* Strong organization, judgment, discretion, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and escalate issues appropriately.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to prepare accurate materials for leadership, committees, auditors, regulators, and other stakeholders.
* Knowledge of records management, confidentiality requirements, and administrative controls.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
* Familiarity with Power Query, Power BI, SQL, Access, or comparable tools is preferred.

**Why FHLBank San Francisco**

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Program Manager, Clinical Trials** will run the day-to-day work of every agentic AI clinical trial we conduct, across **pre-trial, active trial, and post-trial** phases. You will work with internal clinical, research, regulatory, and engineering teams, and serve as the main operational contact for CROs and health system partners. You will be accountable for the success of each clinical program.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Pre-Trial**

* Work with clinical and research leads on study design, protocols, endpoints, and data collection strategy, including CRFs, EDC, and AI agent interaction data.
* Select and manage CROs and vendors: scopes of work, budgets, and contracts.
* Engage health system partners on site feasibility, contracting, and study startup.
* Coordinate IRB submissions, informed consent, data use agreements, and HIPAA reviews.
* Build integrated study plans covering timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risks.

### **During Trial**

* Manage daily trial operations across sites, CROs, and internal teams so studies stay on schedule, on budget, and on protocol.
* Track enrollment, retention, site performance, and data quality. Resolve issues as they arise.
* Coordinate trial logistics, including AI agent deployment with engineering, site training, and study materials.
* Make sure adverse events and AI-related safety escalations are tracked and reported according to protocol.
* Report progress, risks, and needed decisions to leadership.

### **Post-Trial**

* Lead close-out activities: database lock, site close-out, and vendor reconciliation.
* Support clinical study reports, regulatory submissions (e.g., FDA 510(k) or De Novo), and publications.
* Improve SOPs and playbooks so clinical operations can scale across a growing portfolio.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **Required**

* **5+ years managing clinical studies or trials in digital health**, specifically for **Generative AI and/or AI/ML medical devices (SaMD)**.
* End-to-end trial experience, from protocol development through close-out.
* Proven experience managing CROs and multi-site health system partnerships.
* Working knowledge of GCP (ICH E6), IRB processes, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA regulations for SaMD.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to run multiple studies at the same time.
* Excellent communication skills with clinicians, engineers, executives, and external partners.
* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, health sciences, engineering, or a related field.

### **Preferred**

* Advanced degree (MS, MPH, PhD, RN, or similar). PMP or CCRP certification.
* Familiarity with FDA guidance on AI/ML-enabled devices, GMLP, and PCCPs.
* Experience with pragmatic, decentralized, or real-world evidence studies.
* Startup or high-growth company experience.

**Why Join Us**

Help generate the first rigorous clinical evidence for safe generative AI agents in healthcare, working alongside world-class clinicians and AI engineers. We offer competitive salary, equity, and benefits.

*Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer.*

**Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Customer Success
new_jobs.description:
**Why we're hiring**
--------------------

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage. Our product is the operating system our own teams run on: voice AI intake, placements, instant quoting, sales, service and retention, plus the operator tools that tie them together. Each module has engineers, a forward-deployed pod and operators who live in it every day, but not enough product ownership to decide what to build, measure whether it worked, and keep the module coherent as it scales. This hire closes that gap. Each PM becomes the single owner of a module's outcomes: its KPIs, its roadmap and the operator experience inside it.

**Experience:** 5–8 years. **Scope:** Service (Customer Success)  
  
**About the role**

You own a product area that spans more than one team and more than one quarter. Nobody hands you the problem list; you find the problems worth solving, decide which to bet on, and are accountable for the outcome even when the work runs through several pods.

Service is the clearest example. It touches endorsements, certificates, renewals, billing and claims support, and today a lot of it runs on human effort. The Senior PM decides what gets productized, what stays operator-owned, and in what order.

### **What you'll own**

* **Outcomes, not features.** Propose the KPI set for your area and defend why those are the right targets. At least one should trace to a company top-line number (revenue, retention, cost per policy).
* **A 3–6 month roadmap** with clear bets, sequencing and kill criteria.
* **Growth avenues.** Look past optimizing today's funnel: new segments, use cases, or ways to expand revenue per account.
* **Cross-team delivery.** Break initiatives into plans other people can execute; chase dependencies directly; re-plan out loud the moment reality changes.
* **Ops partnership.** Be embedded enough that operators treat you as a peer on process. Turn recurring operational pain into bets with clear ROI.
* **Raising the bar.** Mentor the PM on specs and prioritization; own a stage of the PM interview loop.

  **Logistics**
  -------------

  + **Compensation:** $125,000–$170,000 base + performance bonus + equity.
  + **Location:** San Francisco, in-office. Based here or willing to relocate.
  + **Benefits:** Uber commuter benefits; breakfast, lunch, and dinner provided; snacks and coffee stocked; free gym membership; health, dental, and vision.

  **To apply:** Commercial insurance has never been rebuilt, and the gap between what frontier models make possible and what's actually shipped in this industry is the largest it will ever be. If you want to own a module that touches real customers from week one — send your resume and tell us about something you built that moved a number.

Compensation Range: $125K - $170K

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Nimble is hiring an **Enterprise Account Manager** to own retention and revenue growth across a portfolio of enterprise customers.

You will lead the commercial relationship from post-sale handoff through renewal and expansion, building a deep understanding of customers’ technical priorities and translating measurable value into growing partnerships.

This is a hands-on, quota-carrying role that combines strategic account management, enterprise selling, and customer advocacy. You will work closely with technical stakeholders and executive buyers to identify new use cases, expand adoption, and negotiate agreements that support long-term growth.

  
Requirements:
  

* **3+ years in enterprise SaaS Account Management, Sales, or commercially accountable Customer Success roles.**
* A proven record of **meeting or exceeding renewal and expansion quotas**, with direct ownership of commercial outcomes.
* Experience managing **complex enterprise accounts**, including multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, and contract negotiations.
* Strong discovery and account planning skills, with the ability to turn customer needs into qualified opportunities and closed revenue.
* Experience working with **technical stakeholders**, such as Data, AI, Engineering, or BI teams, and connecting technical capabilities to business value.
* Strong commercial judgment, including the ability to navigate pricing discussions, handle objections, and negotiate agreements.
* Discipline in pipeline management, CRM hygiene, and revenue forecasting.
* Clear communication and the ability to build credibility with both technical teams and executive buyers.
* Comfort working in a startup environment, balancing portfolio ownership with the opportunity to help build a growing function.

  
Responsibilities:
  

* **Own customer growth, retention, and NRR targets** across your portfolio, with direct accountability for renewals and existing-customer revenue growth.
* **Manage renewal and expansion opportunities from discovery through close**, including qualification, proposals, negotiation, and procurement.
* **Build and execute strategic account plans** that connect customer priorities with new use cases, broader adoption, and revenue opportunities.
* **Develop relationships across each account**, engaging technical users, internal champions, executive sponsors, and economic buyers.
* **Identify and develop expansion opportunities** by understanding customers’ workflows, business objectives, and unmet needs.
* **Lead business reviews** that demonstrate measurable value, align on customer priorities, and establish clear next steps.
* **Maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast**, with visibility into renewal timing, expansion potential, commercial risks, and actions needed to close.
* **Identify and address retention risks early**, coordinating with Solutions, Product, and Engineering to resolve barriers to customer value.
* **Partner with Sales on customer handoffs** to establish continuity around commitments, stakeholder relationships, and growth potential.
* **Help build the Account Management motion**, contributing practical account planning templates, renewal processes, and expansion playbooks.

  
About us:  
  

Nimble is the company leading the AI web search category. Our products are used by leading businesses in financial services, retail, market intelligence, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with accurate, auditable programmatic access to the web.

We've raised over $70 million from Norwest, Databricks Ventures, Target Global, Square Peg, and others to build expert-level web search for AI. Hundreds of enterprise customers already run on Nimble, and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, researchers, designers, marketers, sellers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.

**Why join Nimble?**

* Work on a deeply technical platform powering real-time AI and enterprise decisions
* Help define the future of Web Search Agents and live web intelligence
* Build alongside a sharp, mission-driven team that moves fast, ships often, and takes ownership

* **Advocate for Clients.**
  + Act as the client's advocate within Wonderlic, improving the client experience to strengthen retention.

The Regional Operations Manager leads the performance of a group of manufactured housing communities. The role coaches Community Managers, protects resident satisfaction and property standards, and delivers occupancy, revenue, expense, and sales results for the region.

**Financial Performance**

* Prepare annual community operating budgets with Community Managers and the finance team, building the occupancy, rent, sales, expense, and capital assumptions for each community; recommend final budgets for approval; and manage variances to budget.

* Providing direction and coordination of project environmental requirements, tasks, and activities

* Documenting splicing requirements and maintaining fiber engineering documentation

* Maintaining up-to-date network maps in Vero’s proprietary geospatial project management platform, including in-flight design changes and final as-built routes
* Providing accurate network maps to state 811 agencies and Vero Networks NOC
* Managing network maintenance and relocation projects (including emergency maintenance)

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 2+ years of experience in project management, fiber network engineering, or telecom infrastructure deployment
* 2+ years experience in OSP fiber construction
* Ability to develop and manage detailed project schedules, budgets, and scopes of work
* Analytical and organizational skills, with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Vendor management and communication skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field
* Thorough understanding of fiber network cost structure and ability to identify and achieve costs savings during project execution
* Understanding of fiber engineering and documentation standards and principles
* Proficiency using mapping tools (e.g., Google Earth or similar GIS platforms)
* Familiarity with environmental permitting processes and regulations
* Experience using or managing data in proprietary geospatial or project management platforms
* Working knowledge of fiber optic equipment, network architecture, and splicing documentation
* Experience supporting state 811 programs, NOC coordination, and network maintenance or relocation efforts

**JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* This role requires occasional travel up to 10% of the time for activities such as out-of-town meetings, training, or outreach activities.

* This is a staff position.

* This is a Full-Time position.
* This is a Remote position.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* Base pay is paid at an annual salary rate. The range for this position is $105,000 to $120,000 depending on experience.

* Paid life insurance, short-term disability insurance, paid medical plans, PTO, holidays.
* Dental and vision options.
* 401(k) with match.

**ABOUT VERO**

Vero was founded in 2017 with a focus on bridging the digital divide by serving schools and libraries in unserved and underserved areas. We have also established a fiber to the premises business that directly serves residential and small business customers in underserved regions. In addition, we now serve a small subset of large business and wholesale customers - which we typically use as a springboard for our consumer focused services for underserved communities. Our management team brings decades of experience in building and operating fiber networks for various customer segments, including residential, business, and wholesale clients.

new_jobs.title: Innovation and Implementation Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Pathways 2 Solutions, Inc. (Pathways) is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business helping government and commercial clients turn complex challenges into practical solutions. Our capabilities span strategic communications, technology, training, program management, and organizational improvement. We bring together experienced professionals who combine creative thinking with disciplined execution to help clients achieve measurable results.  
  
We help clients develop programs, introduce new technologies, engage stakeholders, and equip people with the knowledge and resources to succeed. Our work with the Department of Veterans Affairs supports initiatives that improve the Veteran experience. We welcome professionals who bring sound judgment, fresh ideas, and a commitment to delivering useful, reliable work.

**Position Overview**
=====================

Working under the direction of the assigned Pod Lead or Implementation Lead, the Specialist provides hands-on research, analysis, coordination, and implementation support across concurrent DRHCI initiatives. The Innovation and Implementation Specialist carries the business case for each assigned project from its start to its transition. At the front end, market research that validates the problem and establishes the project charter; at the back end, develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard, updated market research, analysis of alternatives, and budget estimates that a project needs to transition to the Digital Health Office for enterprise scaling.  
The role contributes throughout the innovation lifecycle from understanding the problem and assessing local readiness to supporting pilots, gathering feedback, refining implementation approaches, and preparing resources for continued use. The Specialist applies sound judgment to assess information, identify gaps, and recommend practical solutions appropriate to the intended users and implementation setting.  
For assigned business-process activities, the Specialist carries forward the evidence and assumptions supporting a project’s business case from initial problem validation through pilot results and consideration for enterprise scaling. The role coordinates market research, project charters, value scorecards, and resource estimates, drawing on the data and evaluation team for measurement methodology and validated outcome data.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
===============================

* Supports market research for assigned projects, partnering with innovators to complete the Market Research Guide validating the problem, quantifying scope and impact, and assessing the market landscape to determine best value for VA.
* Coordinates creation of Project Charters outlining scope, resources, roles, and responsibilities to authorize and structure each assigned project.
* Develops the Lean Business Case and Value Scorecard for assigned projects transitioning to DHO, including measured impact against baseline and validated cost savings and ROI supported by evidence.
* Summarizes lessons learned, changes to assumptions, and unintended consequences for assigned projects.
* Socializes the business case with DHO and relevant local and national parties, gathering feedback and adapting scope as necessary.
* Updates market research to account for new analyses of alternatives and projected demand within VA as a project matures.
* Reassesses resource and funding needs for scaling, including additional costs for communications, training, and evaluation support, and produces budget estimate reporting.
* Contributes to the shared tracking system with DHO monitoring projects in transition and those accepted into the scaling pipeline.
* Works with the Data & Evaluation Lead to ensure the metrics and baselines committed at charter are the ones the business case will need at the end. Supports coordination meetings with DHO and relevant program offices to review scaling pipeline candidates and align priorities.

**Leadership Expectations**
===========================

This position has no formal supervisory responsibility. The Specialist is expected to take ownership of assigned work, collaborate effectively, maintain accurate status information, and communicate barriers early.  
The role may coordinate working sessions and contributions from multiple stakeholders. Decisions involving clinical practice, technology configuration, security authorization, procurement, resource commitments, or changes in scope are elevated to the appropriate authorized personnel.  
For business-process assignments, the Specialist works with the assigned innovation pod lead and designated data and evaluation personnel to maintain consistency between project assumptions, measurement methods, validated results, and scaling recommendations. Approval of project charters, funding commitments, procurement approaches, and enterprise scaling remains with authorized personnel.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Five or more years in business analysis, program analysis, or management consulting involving business case development.
* Demonstrated experience conducting market research or analysis of alternatives to support a build, buy, or reuse decision.
* Experience developing a business case with cost and benefit analysis that a skeptical reviewer accepted.
* Experience producing project charters and structuring project scope, roles, and responsibilities.
* Ability to work with quantitative evaluation data without owning the analysis, and to represent it honestly including its limits.
* Strong written communication for executive audiences.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools, including Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, and the ability to learn required tracking and reporting platforms.
* Ability to obtain a VA background investigation or public trust determination.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting digital health

**Work That Fits Your Life**

* **Fully remote, anywhere in the U.S.** We're headquartered in Chicago, but your office is wherever you do your best work.

You don't have to be a scientist to be part of the science. Every job here, from sales and marketing to product and engineering, helps turn that science into better talent insights for our customers.

* **Our Mission.** Wonderlic's mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job.

-------------

Wonderlic is seeking a **Senior Account Manager, Talent Development Solutions** to drive revenue growth within our existing customer base. This role is responsible for creating and closing cross-sell and expansion opportunities, with a primary focus on expanding cross-sell of Wonderlic Develop. We are building a revenue engine grounded in value-based selling—where every conversation connects talent decisions to measurable business outcomes such as performance, retention, and productivity.

This is **not a renewal role, it is a quota carrying sales role**—you will partner closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), who own retention and account health, while you focus on identifying, creating, and closing new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.

This role requires the mindset and skillset of a top-performing Sales Account Executive, applied within an existing customer base. You will operate as a strategic seller inside the install base, bringing a strong point of view on how customers can solve critical business challenges related to hiring, development, and workforce performance.

**Your Impact:**
----------------

As a Senior Account Manager, Talent Development Solutions, you will drive measurable revenue growth within our existing customer base by identifying, creating, and closing cross-sell opportunities. You will turn existing relationships into strategic growth engines—expanding adoption of Wonderlic solutions by connecting talent decisions to business outcomes such as retention, performance, and productivity. Your success will directly impact net revenue retention, product adoption, and long-term customer value.

**What You'll Do:**

Identify new stakeholders, departments, and use cases within existing accounts to uncover cross-sell opportunities. Leverage internal signals (product usage, hiring trends, organizational changes) to trigger expansion plays. Generate pipeline independent of Customer Success; Customer Success is a strategic partner, not the primary source of opportunities.

Align solutions to broader business objectives and executive-level key performance indicators. Position Wonderlic solutions using a value-based approach—avoiding feature-led selling.
* **Sales Cycle Management:** Manage opportunities through the sales cycle from discovery and solution alignment to business case and close, while navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups (Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, Executives, and others). * **Market Insight:** Maintain strong knowledge of new and existing product offerings, industry trends, new developments, and current competitive conditions within the marketplace.

**What Success Looks Like:**
----------------------------

* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion quota
* Maintain 3–5x pipeline coverage driven by self-sourced opportunities
* Demonstrate strong conversion from discovery to close
* Lead executive conversations that elevate from product to business impact
* Expand relationships across multiple stakeholders and functions

**What We're Looking For:**
---------------------------

#### **Skills & Capabilities**

* Exceptional discovery skills—ability to uncover and monetize customer pain
* Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders
* Skilled in negotiation and closing

**About Edstruments**

Edstruments empowers K12 and nonprofit leaders with modern financial software spanning the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle and Budget Planning & Management. Our platform helps our partners align their spending and budgets to strategic objectives so that they can best achieve their mission. As a fast-growing startup, we add several new partners each month, and our platform is currently in use by organizations across multiple states in the US. We are seeking individuals who are excited to play a critical role in helping our partners achieve their missions.

**A Note on the Role Title**

We are posting this role as Customer Success Associate, which is the more standard market title. At Edstruments, our customers are called partners, so internally you will hear this role referred to as Partner Success Associate (or PSA). Same role, different vocabulary. We default to “partner” language throughout our team, our tools, and our documentation, and your day-to-day will use that language too.

**Role Overview**

The Customer Success Associate will support a portfolio of partners by leading onboarding, check-ins, and virtual training sessions, and by providing responsive, day-to-day support. You will be the primary contact for a group of partners, and you are expected to complete assigned partner-facing and partner-record tasks on time and accurately within established workflows. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow toward a senior partner-facing role, taking on a larger portfolio and more complex partners over time.

**This Is Not a New-Business Sales Role**

This is not a new-business sales role. You will not be prospecting cold customers or carrying a new-logo quota. Expansion opportunities surface inside existing partner relationships through real conversations about partner needs, not through sales motions, and you will work them as part of your check-in and renewal work. If an expansion idea stalls with a partner, you can pull in a Customer Success Manager for support, but the partner relationship stays with you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Onboarding & Adoption: Successfully onboard assigned partners, ensuring they are set up to use the platform effectively and are familiar with features relevant to their goals, including uploads to our app as part of onboarding and ongoing support. [Within the first 60 days of partner handoff]
* Lead Virtual Check-ins & Trainings: Independently lead virtual partner check-ins and training sessions over Zoom to maintain engagement and guide usage of the platform. [Able to lead a check-in within 30 days of starting; able to lead a training within 60 days]
* Partner Communication: Respond to day-to-day questions across email, chat, and live meetings, resolving issues independently when possible and escalating when needed.
* Documentation & Enablement Support: Make small/light edits to internal or partner-facing documentation as assigned, and create basic training videos (with light video editing) to support consistent, scalable partner experience. [Assigned tasks completed within 5 business days]
* Expansion Opportunities: Identify and pursue at least 2 expansion opportunities with your assigned partners. The emphasis is leveraging positive relationships, known partner needs, and ongoing outreach to drive successful outcomes for partners. If an idea stalls with a partner, you can pull in a Customer Success Manager for support. [Within the first 6 months of joining]
* Renewal Prep: Draft renewal letters and pricing for assigned partners, route drafts through internal approval, and send approved renewals to your own partners by their deadlines. [100% of renewals supported on time]
* Partner Record Keeping: Keep partner details, tasks, notes, and tracking up to date across systems like Trello, Coda, HubSpot, Intercom, and Slack so that handoffs are clean and follow-up is timely. [Ongoing]

**Key Outcomes**

* Successfully onboard assigned partners [within 60 days] of handoff
* Able to lead a check-in within 30 days of starting and a training session within 60 days
* Respond to and resolve at least 80% of success-related inquiries for assigned partners
* Complete documentation or training video tasks [within 5 business days]
* Deliver pricing updates and draft invoice templates [on time for 100% of renewal cycles]
* Accurately perform partner data uploads as part of onboarding and support

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in customer success, account coordination, onboarding, or project support, preferably in tech, education, or nonprofit environments
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to guide partners through new tools and explain technical concepts clearly
* High attention to detail, especially in executing partner-facing tasks like training follow-ups, pricing updates, and uploads
* Proven ability to work independently while managing multiple accounts or projects
* Demonstrated interest in learning and mastering software tools
* Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to draft communications, summarize partner notes, and accelerate documentation work; curious about how AI can speed up your own day-to-day
* Familiarity with or willingness to learn tools like Trello, Coda, Loom, HubSpot, and Intercom

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting partners or customers in a SaaS, EdTech, or nonprofit context
* Exposure to data-heavy workflows (e.g., spreadsheets, CSV uploads) and a comfort level with light troubleshooting
* Experience creating or editing training content (e.g., help center articles, Loom videos)
* Familiarity with budgeting/financial tools or interest in the education finance space
